notes.title: Challenges!
notes.content:
Challenges are new content for those who have completed the main game and who want to test their strength.

Challenges will become available after completing (or losing) any expedition after the third one. Mita will fill you in on the details as soon as you have access to them.

Before starting the expedition, you will be able to select Challenges from the list of available ones. Each chosen Challenge increases the Darkness Level. The higher the Darkness Level, the more difficult the expedition will be. At the same time, a high Darkness Level allows you to select some Incentives to make some aspects of the game easier.

Thus, you can flexibly control the difficulty of the expedition, making the game harder (always) or easier (sometimes).

For example, you can choose the Challenges "Titan" (all enemies gain more HP) and "Defenseless" (all enemies deal more damage), increasing the Darkness Level to 5, which will unlock the ability to select the Incentive "On the way to success" (guarantees the tower upgrade after each level). Or you can collect any other combination, there are many options.

Any Incentive lowers the Darkness Level (down to 0), which in turn affects the reward for completing the expedition. Additional Scraps of Matter act as a reward, their number depends on the Darkness Level.

Some Challenges are not compatible with each other and cannot be selected together. The same applies to Incentives.

Good luck!

===============

List of changes in version 1.07:
- Challenges;
- balance changes;
- new achievements related to Challenges;
- an additional cut-scene upon completion of the 20th expedition (if you have already completed so many expeditions, the scene will still be shown after the completion of the next expedition).

notes.title: Future plans
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A major update is planned for the coming months: Challenges.
How will it work? After completing several Expeditions, you will be able to choose one or more Challenge that change game rules. For example, you can turn off stores on planets or disable restoring HP, or strengthen opponents. How about getting all possible damage effects from the very first level, but at the same time losing the ability to improve them? Or maybe you want to complete the entire expedition with 1 HP?

To make the Challenges more fair, the level rewards in such expeditions will also be improved.

What other Challenges would you like to see?

notes.title: Release 1.06
notes.content:
Sometimes in the later stages the game can be too difficult, almost impossible.
To help players weather this storm, an adaptive difficulty system has been introduced that takes into account the successes and failures of the player.

In this regard, several new achievements have also been added.

Good luck fighting the Darkness!

notes.title: Release 1.05
Release!
notes.content:
I am glad to say that the development of TD Worlds has been successfully completed and the game is available for everyone!

To celebrate such an event, there will be a 10% discount all week.

notes.title: Twitch integration
notes.content:
So how can the audience play with you?

Everything is very simple. To get started, you will need to go to the game settings and enter your Twitch channel name and just start playing (streamer mode will be disabled during the very first expedition so that you can get comfortable with the basic principles of the game before your viewers can change the rules ).

From time to time, a panel with three voting options will appear at the top. In order to vote, the viewer simply needs to send the number of the desired option to the chat, for example 1, 2 or 3. 25 seconds are allocated for voting. If 2 or more options have received the same number of votes, then a random one is selected.

Nothing complicated, isn't it?

And now the most interesting thing is what the audience can vote for. Or they can practically anything. Prevent streamer from placing towers for 10 seconds? Easily! Destroy all enemies on the level, increase the player's power, increase the cost of goods in the shop - no problem.
Moreover, as the game progresses, more and more positive and negative effects are revealed, which makes the game even more interesting and less predictable.

Most of the effects are instantaneous and only apply to already installed towers and enemies on the screen, but this is not a strict rule.

The game mode with viewers will be available in the release version of the game.

An example of how the integration works:
[previewyoutube=LbkNSZOukT4;full][/previewyoutube]

If you do not have your own channel or viewers, this is still not a problem, because this way you will receive a random "bonus" from those offered. Much the same as in the case when the votes of the audience are equally divided between the options.

notes.title: Time travel?
notes.content:
In this update, you will have the long-awaited ability to [i]speed up time[/i], which will allow you to complete levels even faster!

But how do you get this ability? Try to ask [b]Supar[/b], these scientists are always coming up with something.

Beware, such a strong ability can place a serious strain on your device.

If you notice any issues related to time speed, please leave a comment about it.
